spans.s: (I)--a god of the आभूतरय group. Br. II. ७६. ५६.
(III)--a son of Dharma and father of दृढ- sena. Vi. IV. २३. 6-7.
--a sage who waited on परशुराम with other sages for the reclamation of गोकर्ण and insisted that an established rule may be broken for the sake of धर्म। Br. III. ५७. 1, २३-4.

--created by वासुदेव for van- quishing the Asuras by name Andhakas at the request of Rudra; she drank their blood and destroyed the whole lot; aided नृसिम्ह in creating further mother goddesses to over- power the मातृ gan2a of Rudra;
1: M. १७९. ३६. ६५.
will grant children if wor- shipped.
2: Ib. १७९. ८५.
(I)--a king of Trigarttas and the prince a vassal of युधिष्ठिर: went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse. भा. X. ५२. ११ [१४]; ८२. २६.

(II)--a कण्व king after नारायण was killed by his servant, a वृषल and आन्ध्र ja1ti1ya, who usurped the kingdom. After some time his brother कृष्ण, became king: ruled for four years (ten years म्। प्।);
1: भा.

; Br. III. ७४. १५९.
a son of [page३-673+ २५] नारायण; with him the कण्व dynasty came to an end; killed by his servant Balipucchaka, an Andhra. ^2 वा. ९९. ३४६-48; Vi. IV. २४. ४१-3.

(III)--a pupil of सूत;
1: वा. ६१. ५६.
versed in the पुराणस्।
2: Br. II. ३५. ६४.
(I)--the son of शान्ति and father of Puruja (Puramjaya-वि। प्।). भा. IX. २१. ३१; Vi. IV. १९. ५७.
(II)--Indra of the Uttama epoch of Manu. Br. II. ३६. ३७; Vi.
--a देवी; a daughter of the Madra king and a queen of कृष्ण; highly chaste. M. ४७. १४; वा. ९६. २३४; Vi. V. २८. 4.
--a बृहद्रथ; ruled for ३८ years. Br. III. ७४. ११८.
(I)--a son of Suvarcas (सुभाष-वि। प्।) and father of Jaya. Br. III. ६४. २१; Vi.
(I)--one of the seven important rays of the sun by which the waning moon is fed. Br. II. २३. ३८, ६१, ७४; २४. ६६; २८. २८; वा. ५२. ३७ and ५७; ५३. ४६; ५६. २७; Vi. II. ११. २२.
(II)--a sacred pool in the हिमालयस्, fit for श्राद्ध. Br. III. १३. १२३-4; वा. ७७. ११५.
(I)--a son of कृष्ण and रुक्मिणी. भा. I. १४. ३१; Vi. V. २८. 1.
(II)--a chief of the क्रोधावश group of serpents. भा. V. २४. २९.
(IV)--a son of वृष्टिमत्, and father of सुनीथ (नृचक्षु, ब्। प्।). भा. IX. २२. ४१; M. ५०. ८१; Vi. IV. २१. १२.
(V)--a son of Vasudeva and देवकी; killed by Kamsa. भा. IX. २४. ५४; Br. III. ७१. १७४; M. ४६. १३. वा. ९६. १७२; Vi. IV. १५. २६-27.
(VI)--the Gandharva presiding over the month of Tapas. भा. XII. ११. ३९.
(VII)--a ग्रामणि with the शरत् sun. Br. II. २३. १४; वा. ५२. १४.

(VIII)--a marut of the second गण;

(II)--a son of प्रसुश्रुत(ka) and father of अमर्ष. वा. ८८. २११; Vi.
--a group of Gods of the Raivata. Vi.
--a son of Raivata Manu. Br. II. ३६. ६३. [page३-677+ २६]
--the सभा of Vaivasvata, on the third inner slope of Meru. वा. ३४. ८६.
--with the sun in the Madhu and माधव months. Br. II. २३. 4.
--पितृस् who live in the region of कामदुघा. M. १५. २०.
